title: run_all_tests.ipynb

canonical_node.axiom: A test runner that executes all tests without chart generation is sufficient for verification of pass/fail results.
definitions: Test runner: a notebook that executes the full test suite and outputs pass/fail results.
Full runner: a notebook that executes tests and generates charts and visualizations.
Verification: confirmation of pass/fail results without visual output.
derivation: The document states that run_all_tests.ipynb runs all tests but skips chart generation.
It states that this is faster and suitable for verification purposes.
It states that the test runner produces results in under 5 minutes, while the full runner takes 8-12 minutes.
It states that the test runner is the verification artifact for the website.
canonical_node.action: Execute all tests and output pass/fail results without generating charts, for verification purposes.
boundary: Does not generate charts or visualizations.
Does not replace the full runner for presentations or website output.
Does not alter the test suite or its results.
test: Run the notebook and confirm all tests execute and pass/fail results are produced.
Confirm no chart files are generated.
Confirm runtime is under 5 minutes on a CPU instance.

dg1_dependencies: run_all.ipynb (full runner) as the source of the test suite and expected results.
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a faster, leaner verification path that does not require chart generation.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the ability to verify pass/fail results of all tests.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this runner, verification would require running the full runner, which is slower and includes unnecessary chart generation.

overstatement_risks: The document implies that the test runner is sufficient for verification, but does not provide evidence that the tests themselves are correct or complete.
The claim that the test runner is a 'sign of a mature test suite' is subjective and not supported by data.
kill_conditions: If the test runner does not actually run all tests or produces incorrect results.
If the test suite itself is invalid or incomplete.
risk.lean_target: The test runner is a procedural tool; its value depends on the underlying test suite.

plain_summary: This document describes a lean test runner notebook that executes all tests without chart generation, intended for quick verification. It is a procedural artifact, not a proof of any scientific claim.
